title: Small perfect well-generators of a Grothendieck derived category
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian category A with v-small derived Hom spaces [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and coproducts [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts], there are a regular kappa in universe v and an essentially v-small shift-closed class G of kappa-small objects satisfying G4 [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object], such that every replete triangulated class closed under v-small coproducts and containing G contains every object of D(A).

source.place: Neeman, On the derived category of sheaves on a manifold, Theorem 0.2 and Section 2; Alonso--Jeremias--Souto, Localization in categories of complexes and unbounded resolutions, Proposition 5.1; Krause (2001), Theorem A, Theorem C and Lemma 4.

proof.text: Use the existing exact compact localization model of the Grothendieck derived category. Its source is compactly generated, the localization has an invertible counit, and the image of its compact generating family generates the target by the compact-generator telescope theorem.

Apply the ambient perfect small class theorem to the essentially small image of the source compact generators. The resulting canonical alpha-compact class is essentially small, triangulated and closed under bounded coproducts; the alpha-compact API gives smallness and the coproduct factorization class. Since the image generators generate, every localizing class containing the canonical class is all of the derived category.

proof_origin.place: Neeman Theorem 0.2 and Krause Sections 6.2-6.3, reduced in Lean using the existing compact localization model and perfect alpha-compact class API.

lean.statement: theorem derived_exists_perfect_well_generators {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A] : ∃ (G : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A)) (κ : Cardinal.{v}) (_ : Fact κ.IsRegular), ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} G ∧ G.IsStableUnderShift ℤ ∧ (∀ U, G U → IsAlphaSmall U κ) ∧ G.IsCoproductFactorizationClass ∧ ∀ (S : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A)) [S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] [S.IsTriangulated], (∀ (I : Type v) (Y : I → DerivedCategory A), (∀ i, S (Y i)) → S (∐ Y)) → G ≤ S → ∀ U, S U
